label: copy-phase input digit 2, late in the sequence
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only when the fed-back input token is the digit 2 (98% of activation mass). It never fires in the original phase or at <DEL>, and never on the first occurrence of a token. Both rate and magnitude grow with absolute step t and recall position: it is close to silent before t=10, and the rate climbs from 0.4% at t=12 to about 2% at t=16-17, so long sequences (L=8-9) carry about 92% of the mass. Top activations (about 3.5-4.3) are copy-phase 2s at t=13-15. Sequences with more digits have a higher rate. Tiny activations sometimes appear on the token just before a 2 (p, u, k, w). Precision is low: most late copy-phase 2s stay inactive, and no variable tested (prev_tok, next_out, n_digits, L) separates active from inactive cases. Raising the threshold to t>=14 gives dev F1 0.56 but mass recall only 0.77.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: 2, p, u, k, t, w; least: e, 1, n, x) and the token being output (most: 2, p, u, k, o, 3; least: e, y, 0, -); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=7, t=17, recall_idx=8.
